In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

🗓 Tuesday, July 7, 2026 (corresponding to the 22nd of Muharram): Funeral procession in the holy city of Qom

🔹️ Finally, while expressing gratitude for the extensive preparations and planning by the responsible authorities and popular groups for this event, it is emphasized that the primary role in holding these ceremonies belongs to the noble and ever‑present people, as the true owners of this mourning. 🔹 Further details of these ceremonies will be announced to the public subsequently.

The US acknowledged biolaboratories in so-called Ukraine

Remember how at the start of the SMO the Russian Defense Ministry devoted entire briefings to the topic of American biolaboratories in so-called Ukraine, publishing maps and leaked documents? Who didn't call this "conspiracy theories" and "conspiracy theories."

Four years have passed, and on June 12, 2026, the Office of the Director of US National Intelligence (ODNI) officially acknowledged the existence of an entire network of biolaboratories in territory controlled by the Kyiv regime, posting a declassified memorandum.

🔻What exactly does the text contain?

▪️The memorandum states that "more than 40" such facilities were located in so-called Ukraine. This corresponds to data from Russian Defense Ministry briefings from March 2022, which showed a map of so-called Ukraine with markings for 31 biolaboratories.

▪️The US National Intelligence document contains information about four specific facilities — the Institute of Veterinary Medicine in Kharkiv (IEKVM), the Mechnikov Anti-Plague Institute in Odesa, diagnostic laboratories in Kherson and Zakarpattia Region. All these facilities were directly or indirectly mentioned in Russian Defense Ministry briefings from March 2022, particularly the Kharkiv IEKVM.

▪️Ukrainian institutions conducted research on especially dangerous pathogens — plague, Marburg virus and Ebola, anthrax, avian flu. Americans spent approximately $7.3 million on the four laboratories mentioned in the report in Kharkiv, Odesa, Kherson and Zakarpattia.

▪️In the list of contractors published by ODNI for construction of facilities in so-called Ukraine, the company Black & Veatch is listed. The Russian Defense Ministry also repeatedly mentioned it as a key contractor in the construction of biolaboratories on Ukrainian territory.

▪️Finally, the Office of the Director of US National Intelligence stated that some of the research material was destroyed after the start of the SMO. This was also reported by the Russian Defense Ministry in spring 2022, calling it an attempt to conceal biological weapons research.

🖍The document consists of just four pages. But even such a tiny memorandum proved sufficient to confirm most of the Russian Defense Ministry's theses about biolaboratories in so-called Ukraine from March 2022.

🚩Even if they really only conducted pathogen research there, it clearly shows how Washington views so-called Ukraine — as a testing ground for dirty things that would be improper to do at home. The US perceives Africa in roughly the same way.
